projects.name: Hotel el descanso
projects.summary: A comprehensive portal for managing guests and rooms in a hotel complex, with advanced role functionalities for different types of users, allowing efficient and personalized administration.

description.value: The Hotel Management System (HMS) is a solution designed for the efficient management of reservations, occupancy, and services at El Descanso hotel. It implements an optimized database, ensuring integrity and normalization up to 3NF.

value: Registration and management of rooms, clients, and reservations.
Management of additional services (restaurant, bar, laundry, etc.).
User profiles with different access levels (manager, receptionist, cashier, administrator).
Generation of invoices and statistics on occupancy and cancellations.
Data modeling: Entity-Relationship Diagram (Chen).
Relational databases: Implementation with functional dependencies and normalization.
Tools: Draw.io for modeling, SQL for data management.
